source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Each time the Plagueburst mortar of this model is given a target in your Shooting phase, roll 1 D6 for that target and for each other enemy unit that is within 3" of it. Add 1 to a unit’s roll if it is Afflicted. Each unit whose roll is 6+ is struck by spores.

Once this model has resolved all its attacks against that target, every unit struck by spores takes D3 mortal wounds.
